# Kumobi SoundPod S3 Product Specifications

Model number: KM-SP300

The Kumobi SoundPod S3 (model KM-SP300) is a waterproof portable speaker for indoor and outdoor use. These specifications describe the product as of March 1, 2027.

## 1 Body

| Item | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Width | 120 mm |
| Height | 80 mm |
| Depth | 45 mm |
| Weight | 410 g |
| Water resistance | IPX7 |
| Body colors | Black, white, blue |

The width is 4.7 in, small enough to hold in one hand.

The weight is 410 g, so it fits in a bag with the strap attached.

## 2 Battery

| Item | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Battery capacity | 5000 mAh |
| Current draw (50% volume) | 500 mA |
| Playback time (50% volume) | 10 hours |
| Charging time | 3 hours |
| Charging port | USB Type-C |

The playback time is measured at 50% volume with our test tracks. It is shorter at a higher volume.

## 3 Wireless

| Item | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Bluetooth | 5.3 |
| Range | 10 m |
| Codecs | SBC, AAC |

## 4 Firmware history

| Version | Released | Changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.0.0 | November 20, 2026 | First release |
| 1.1.0 | December 15, 2026 | More stable connection |
| 1.2.0 | January 20, 2027 | Bass boost mode added |
| 1.3.0 | February 10, 2027 | Better battery level display |
| 1.4.0 | February 25, 2027 | Playback on two speakers at once |

## 5 Contact

When you request a repair, give the model number KM-SP300 and the serial number. The serial number is printed on the bottom of the speaker.

Kumobi Inc. Customer Support, phone: 1-800-555-0100 (weekdays, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.)
